mapper.select: SELECT userId, userName, userRole, loginId, password, phone, email, linkCode, pushToken, regDt, updDt FROM USERS WHERE linkCode = #{linkCode} AND userRole = 'USER'
SELECT userId, userName, userRole, loginId, password, phone, email, linkCode, pushToken, regDt, updDt FROM USERS WHERE loginId = #{loginId}
SELECT guardianUser.userName FROM GUARDIAN_LINKS gl INNER JOIN USERS guardianUser ON gl.guardianId = guardianUser.userId WHERE gl.userId = #{userId}
SELECT linkedUser.userName FROM GUARDIAN_LINKS gl INNER JOIN USERS linkedUser ON gl.userId = linkedUser.userId WHERE gl.guardianId = #{guardianId}
SELECT userId, userName, userRole, loginId, phone, email, linkCode FROM USERS WHERE userId = #{userId}
SELECT userId, shareLocationYn, deviationAlarmYn, arrivalAlarmYn, voiceGuideYn, checkpointAlarmYn, helpRequestMessage, regDt, updDt FROM USER_SETTINGS WHERE userId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( userName, userRole, loginId, password, phone, email, linkCode, pushToken ) VALUES ( #{userName}, #{userRole}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{linkCode}, #{pushToken} )
